svg.title: workstation-steward: a host audit, then tidying up after the soak
svg.desc: An illustrative session, looping, in three scenes. steward sc audit runs its twelve checks, one row each, with what it found in columns under the check (a mise release past the gate, a Homebrew formula still held, a browser to update now, a container on a floating tag), and ends with a summary listing the three actions under what to do about each. Three days after an upgrade, the steward banner and steward sc soak say the soak is over. steward sc prune lists the old versions no config needs, previews the removal, asks, and removes them.

text.tspan: by hand: pin each image by tag@digest
7 check(s) have more lines: steward sc audit --verbose
